findings.title: Cloud sync failed: "Failed to get Sync Object Detail" (8335) (1)
findings.detail: The cloud backend returned error 8335 while the controller fetched a sync object; that object (e.g. zones) was not synced on this pass.
findings.fix: Check whether the next sync succeeded; repeated 8335 errors are a cloud-side issue to report.
